name: mochi-crew
description: A pixel-art cat companion that lives in a side pane and reacts to your real Claude Code session: edits, commands, subagents, turns, tests and bugs, with XP, missions, a session journal, and a session meter for model, context, prompt cache and limits or cost, and a live file tree of where Claude is working, plus a session badge that tints each session's Terminal tab and puts a matching emoji in its title.
